import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a scatter plot of Price vs Megapixels, colored by Sensor Type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k',
                          palette='Set2', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price in USD')
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type with 4K Video Capability Indication')

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
